title: Restraining Order

signers.label: Approving Judge
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval -- not part of the intake handoff flow.

notes: Built from Bar Procedures Section 7C. A TRO is filed with a Law Enforcement Officer and valid for 7 days. A Full Restraining Order requires a court petition and runs from 7 days up to 6 months. This form covers both scenarios -- the 'order_type' field determines which. The approving judge field is filled by whichever authority (LEO for TRO, Judge/Justice for Full Order) approves the request.

fields.label: Type of Order
fields.prompt:
What kind of order do you need? Pick one:
- Temporary Restraining Order (TRO) — for immediate, short-term protection. Granted by a police officer, lasts up to 7 days.
- Full Restraining Order — for longer-term protection. Goes through a judge, can last up to 6 months.

fields.label: Order Duration
fields.prompt:
How long do you need this order to last?
- TROs: maximum 7 days
- Full orders: anywhere from 7 days up to 6 months
Just write the number of days (e.g. "7 days" or "3 months").

fields.label: Petitioner
fields.prompt: What is your full name? (The person who needs protection.)

fields.label: Petitioner CID
fields.prompt: Use /cid in city. This will add your CID to your clipboard. Paste that in here please.

fields.label: Respondent Name
fields.prompt: What is the full name of the person you need protection from?

fields.label: Respondent CID
fields.prompt: What is their CID? If you don't have it, type "Unknown".

fields.label: Known Aliases
fields.prompt: Do they go by any other names? If not, just type "None".

fields.label: Protected Locations
fields.prompt: What places should they NOT be allowed near? (e.g. your home, your workplace, a friend's house — include addresses if you have them.)

fields.label: Grounds for Order
fields.prompt: Tell us what happened. Describe the specific incidents of harassment, threats, or violence that made you file for this order. Include dates if you remember them.

fields.label: Terms & Conditions
fields.prompt:
What should this order actually say they can't do? Examples:
- No contacting you by any means
- Stay at least X feet away from you
- Don't come near your home or work
If you're not sure, type "Standard no-contact order" and the judge will set the terms.

fields.label: LEO Badge (if TRO)
fields.prompt:
If a police officer already gave you a temporary order: what's their badge number?
If you're going straight for a Full Order with a judge, type "N/A".

fields.label: Approving Authority
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. For a TRO this is the LEO's name; for a Full Order this is the Judge/Justice's name.

fields.label: Title / Badge
fields.note: e.g. 'Police Officer, Badge #1234' for a TRO, or 'Justice of the Supreme Court' for a Full Order.
